references.text: Moses exhorts the people to take care of what they have seen and heard, and to teach it further to their children and grandchildren.
The people of Israel are commanded to keep God's word in their hearts and diligently teach them to their children.
Moses commands the people to lay these words on their hearts and teach them to their children.
Moses is instructed to write down the song as a testimony for the children of Israel.
The people gather to hear the law, so that they may learn to fear the Lord and keep all the words of the law.
Solomon prays that the people will preserve God's word in their hearts and teach their children to fear the Lord.
God gave Israel testimonies and laws that were to be passed on to future generations.
Solomon commands the people to keep God's commandments in order to live.
Ezekiel is commanded to lay all that he sees and hears upon his heart.
The exhortation to pay even more attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it.
